description: Suijin v3.7.0: PHASE 1.5 — the compiled core. native/suijin-core crate (PyO3 abi3): resolve_dag + check_paths, the only two pure data-in/data-out functions. Pure-Python oracle ships as permanent fallback; oracle suite (fixtures + 600-case fuzz) asserts canonical-JSON equality — it caught a real divergence (unsorted core-abort text) and a real algorithm bug (dependents of skipped modules booted anyway) on its first run, fixed in all three implementations. registry.resolve() now delegates graph math to the compiled core. 958 tests green.
